request.subject: UNIT:GUARD

layers.text: Change two things only. The shield: twice as big, a huge tower shield with a flat top and rounded bottom from his chin to the ground, as wide as his body, crimson with the bold gold cross and a thick steel border. His armour: polished steel plate with a big round pauldron and plate arms and legs instead of cloth and mail. Do not redraw anything else: keep the face, kettle helmet, spear, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
